title: German Style Mung Bean Pilaf
description: A hearty and nutritious German-inspired pilaf dish made with mung beans, pilaf, and sprouts.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the mung beans and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the pilaf and sprouts to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the velvety and zesty to the saucepan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the mung beans and pilaf are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
